### UTC Date & Time

[November 16, 2026, 14:00 UTC](https://savvytime.com/converter/utc/nov-16-2026/2pm)

### Agenda

#### Glamsterdam

##### EIP-8037/8038: Compatibility Investigations & Audit Findings

The goal is to establish a shared understanding of the current findings, their impact on deployed contracts, and any remaining uncertainties. This discussion will help inform the next steps at Thursday's ACDE https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2285.

###### Resources

- Ethereum Foundation [blog post](https://blog.ethereum.org/2026/11/06/glamsterdam-8037-8038).
- EthLabs [blog post](https://ethlabs.org/writings/tracking-glamsterdam.html).
- Repository outlining the potentially changed gas invariants: [ethereum/glamsterdam-gas-invariants](https://github.com/ethereum/glamsterdam-gas-invariants).
- EVM Gas Repricing analysis: [misilva73/evm-gas-repricings](https://github.com/misilva73/evm-gas-repricings).
- Initial ChainSecurity report: [Presentation at ACDE #248](https://forkcast.org/calls/acde/248/#t=304), [blog post](https://www.chainsecurity.com/blog/glamsterdam-gas/index.html).

###### 8037/8038 agenda

- **Overview and current status:** @MariusVanDerWijden
- **Independent audit findings:**
  - [ChainSecurity](https://www.chainsecurity.com/): @TanguyRocher-ChainSecurity
  - [Dedaub](https://dedaub.com/): @Dedaub
- **EF internal investigations:** @nerolation, Architecture, EF
- **Application team outreach and contract findings:** @rahul-kothari, EVM Dev Tooling, EF
  - Juicebox protocol compatibility concerns and PoCs, @mejango, resp. @rahul-kothari or @danceratopz, ([comment](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2299#issuecomment-6860064283)).
    - Details: [mejango/glamsterdam-pocs](https://github.com/mejango/glamsterdam-pocs).
- **Open Q&A:** Audit findings, affected contracts, outstanding concerns, and input from application developers

##### Payload Binding: Select a Solution

Follow-up from ACDC. Discuss the two proposed solutions and decide which to adopt to unblock the consensus spec release @jtraglia ([comment](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2299#issuecomment-6831513586)):
- https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5770
- https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5820

Follow up from ACDC, I would like to discuss two possible solutions to the payload binding issue:

* https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5770
* https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5820

We really need to decide on one of these during the call so that we can make a spec release.

Hi, I was told here is the place to add an item I'd like ack'd during the next meeting. 

It's unlikely I'll be able to join the call, but here are the PoC's that exemplify how Glam affects the Juicebox protocol's guarantees and how it strips the protocol of the value it provides users. I'd like clarity on if these issues are above or below the EF's threshold of tolerated breaking changes as it affects my conviction and time spent building/selling immutable business structures which I believe to have tremendous value given a sturdy foundation. 

As an Etherean I urge us to not break invariants that cause these doubts as the affects ripple through the confidence of app developers and our users. Confidence is the one thing we cannot sacrifice in the name of scaling, etc. 

https://github.com/mejango/glamsterdam-pocs

Thank you for all you do!

I want to take at most two minutes to invite people to the EIPIP call next Wednesday: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2288#issuecomment-6845904473

We will discuss adding AI usage to the EIP process at that call. I think this is incredibly important for the entire ecosystem to think about how we should securely do this, such that we keep converging to the same end goals, but now with the help of AI tooling.
